cmsFields.title: Apache Superset review: BI and operational boundaries
cmsFields.subtitle: What must a team operate and secure beyond the dashboard interface?
cmsFields.summary: Apache Superset repository review of BI architecture, metadata, workers and access controls, separating dashboard features from production guarantees.
keyTakeaways: Superset queries analytical data sources while storing its own metadata separately.
Caches and workers are optional only relative to the features a deployment enables.
Role and row-filter features require explicit access testing; a dashboard is not an isolation proof.
